title: Maya's Life as a Teenager
text:
Maya is fifteen years old. She lives in a small town with her parents and her brother. Every day after school, she meets her friends at the park. They talk, play music and eat ice cream.

On Saturdays, Maya works in a bookshop. She likes books about animals and she helps customers find good stories. Her parents say she is very responsible for a teenager.

questions.text: Where does Maya work on Saturdays?
What can we guess about Maya's friends?

options: She has a job and helps customers

people who buy things or services from a shop

paragraph_translations: Maya ma piętnaście lat. Mieszka w małym miasteczku z rodzicami i bratem. Każdego dnia po szkole spotyka się z przyjaciółmi w parku. Rozmawiają, grają na muzyce i jedzą lody.
W soboty Maya pracuje w księgarni. Lubi książki o zwierzętach i pomaga klientom znaleźć dobre historie. Jej rodzice mówią, że jest bardzo odpowiedzialna jak na nastolatkę.
